authorization: 2026-11-12 user: stop DC; try TranAD window100 stride5; run RCR one epoch and add window100 stride5 to existing window32 stride4 baseline. Same LFP/cache/seed and scoring rules.
preprocessing: normal-training-only MinMax; width<1e-12=>1; no clipping; per-snippet NaN/Inf interpolation and nearest endpoint; entirely missing channel=>normal-training valid-observation median
validation_stride: per cell, matching the RCR window stride; TranAD1
checkpoint_selection: Fixed end of epoch1 for every cell, no test-based selection
training_window_policy: all retained normal snippets, stride1 or5, append end-aligned full tail window if necessary; no cross-snippet windows; no window cap
aggregation: mean of largest ceil(0.05*n) native scores per snippet, at least1
threshold: normal validation snippet scores P95, numpy linear quantile, predict >= threshold
evaluation_scope: same fixed test cohort; no point adjustment; no test-based stride/checkpoint selection

native_score.rcr: R=X-Xhat; train-fitted conditional OLS mean/log-RMS scale, min_std0.05, train-scale P5/P95 clipping; mean calibrated squared residual per window

model_identity.rcr: Existing RCRBackbone and Scale, same initial parameters across windows
model_identity.tranad: Author released implementation with explicit project window100 variant; author positional encoding buffer extended100; parameterized architecture unchanged

first_epoch_limitation: TranAD native epoch1 weights are first_loss1 and second_loss0; one-epoch results do not establish final-stage quality or convergence
storage_estimate: Reuse0.31GiB LFP inputs; new checkpoints/scores well below0.2GiB, temporary RCR moments kept in RAM only
runtime_estimate: RCR two cells ~15-30min including refitting and scoring; TranAD100 stride5 ~30-60min including stride1 validation/test. Total roughly45-90min, window100 throughput not yet measured.
validation_diagnostic_limits: One epoch only. TranAD first-stage validation does not assess fully trained second stage. RCR window comparison changes both window length and stride, as explicitly requested.
cache_policy: Training/evaluation read only frozen preprocessed input files, boundaries, metadata and training-only scaler; no original CSV reload or automatic rebuild. Reuse same bundle locally and on Kaggle.
